senses.gloss: (בת, v. בֶּתֶר) to make incisions. Pa. בַּתַּשׁ with ב to urge, beg persistently.
units: <cite ref="Chullin 7b:10">Ḥull. 7ᵇ</cite> <he>הוה מְבַתַּשׁ ביה טובא</he> he begged him very persistently (to accept the invitation).

<cite ref="Shevuot 30b">Shebu. 30ᵇ</cite> <he>בצורבא מרבנן מבתשינן בע״ה לא מבתשינן</he> (Ms. M. <he>מכ׳</he>, with <cite ref="K00000"><he>כ</he></cite>, Rashi with <cite ref="B00000"><he>ב</he></cite>, v. to Ḥull. l. c.; ed. diff. vers.) a scholar is urged to sit down (in court), an ignorant man is not urged. [Ib. <he>בטש ביה ואוקמיה לע״ה</he> (read <he>בת׳</he>) he urged him (the scholar, to sit down) and made the ignorant man stand up; v. <cite ref="B00534"><he>בְּטַשׁ</he></cite> as to vers.]
